description: Look up a Bible verse, a range inside one chapter, or a whole chapter in the KJV or the World English Bible, from Lamplight (https://lamplightverse.com). At most 50 verses per call; split longer passages. References like "John 3:16", "1 Cor 13:4-7" and "Psalm 23" work. The text is the scripture stored on the site, word for word, and it does not change. License: KJV: Public domain outside the United Kingdom; WEB: Dedicated to the public domain. To find verses by theme (anxiety, hope, forgiveness, marriage and more), the topic pages at https://lamplightverse.com/bible-verses-about print 8 to 15 verses each, in full, with a short note on each. Look up any single verse from them here.

reference.description: A verse, a range in one chapter, or a whole chapter: "John 3:16", "1 Cor 13:4-7", "Psalm 23". At most 50 verses.

translation.description: Bible translation: KJV or WEB (World English Bible). Default KJV.
